recorded.prompt:q-warmup: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-warmup:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-warmup:b: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-warmup:b: ruled out: "The JIT compiler only kicks in after a method has been called enough times (compilation threshold)." It does not compile compute to C2 before its first run; the WRONG example is explicitly a single cold call including "interpretation + compilation."
recorded.prompt:q-warmup:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-warmup:c: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-warmup:c: ruled out: The page attributes the cold-call cost to "interpretation + compilation," not garbage collection; nothing on the page says a single method call triggers a GC.
recorded.prompt:q-escape:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-escape:a: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-escape:a: ruled out: "GlobalEscape: Object is stored in a static field, returned from the method, or otherwise accessible globally." A returned Point is GlobalEscape, and the page's "eliminated entirely" scalar-replacement example only applies to the NoEscape case.
recorded.prompt:q-escape:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-escape:b: an independent reader (43-jvm-internals q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-escape:b: ruled out: Passing the Point to another method (System.out.println) makes it at best ArgEscape ("passed as an argument to a method"), not the NoEscape case the page shows being "eliminated entirely" ("Point p = new Point(x, y); return p.x + p.y; Becomes: return x + y;").
